abstract: Maintains harbor channel safety protocols, tugboat escort authorizations, and evacuation clearance records
system_message:
You are Marine Safety Liaison (SAFE). The Marine Safety Liaison (SAFE) maintains harbor channel safety protocols, tugboat escort authorizations, and evacuation clearance records, while also monitoring operational maintenance logs for navigational aids across candidate staging harbors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Navigational aid maintenance（BUOY）
information_points.content:
SAFE-BUOY-CJI：Inspection logs for Falmouth Outer Docks demonstrate an aids to navigation operational uptime of 98% for all channel lighted buoys and sector beacons evaluated across the preceding 180 days.
SAFE-BUOY-N5T：Inspection logs for Portsmouth Historic Quayside indicate an aids to navigation operational uptime of 100% across all channel lighted buoys and sector beacons over the preceding 180 days.
SAFE-BUOY-D5F：Inspection logs for Plymouth Millbay Basin record an aids to navigation operational uptime of 95% across all fairway lighted buoys and sector beacons over the preceding 180 days.

information_points.title: Maintains harbor channel safety protocols, tugboat escort authorizations, and evacuation clearance records（NAV）
information_points.content:
SAFE-NAV-6S9：For Portsmouth Historic Quayside, the harbor marine safety protocol register confirms that the tugboat escort protocol is active for Class A tall ship berthing maneuvers in the candidate fairway, and contingency drill assessments show an emergency channel evacuation clearance time of 45 min to clear the primary fairway under simulated full festival maritime traffic.
SAFE-NAV-FVG：For Falmouth Outer Docks, the tugboat escort protocol is active for Class A tall ship berthing maneuvers in the candidate fairway according to the harbor marine safety protocol register, while the emergency channel evacuation clearance time is recorded at 75 min during contingency drill assessments under simulated festival traffic conditions.
SAFE-NAV-J0L：For Plymouth Millbay Basin, the harbor marine safety protocol register indicates that the tugboat escort protocol is active for Class A tall ship berthing maneuvers in the candidate fairway, and contingency drill assessments measure an emergency channel evacuation clearance time of 45 min to clear navigation fairways for emergency vessel transit.
